title: The Answer in the Faraway Future

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at summer camp with Aston Machan.
After a long day of training,
I'm making
detailed records as I do everyday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's made a lot of progress. Looking back
at her past records, I'm
pleased to see
such steady improvement.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you talking to Mr. Computer?
...Hm? Are these records
about me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Daily records... Lap times, running form,
habits. There's even stuff
here I hadn't
noticed myself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You've recorded so, so much about me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Aston Machan that you'll
remember...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems unusually taken aback. I try
saying something positive to
break the
awkward silence.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A new me every day...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(In that case, what will the Aston Machan
that stays in everyone else's
minds look
like?)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(If I change every day, then each new
memory of me is a new
Machan.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(That means there are lots of different
Aston Machans.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(Ah. Then, in a way... "remembering"
doesn't seem to do it justice.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It feels so, so colorful and vivid.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the sky. Any minute now, flowers
will blossom in the sky. And
when they do,
they'll bloom in the sea, too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go... to that place we'll all end up
some day. Just to look this
time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's much cooler at night, isn't it? And so
very quiet, too. I can hear
the waves loud
and clear.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We stare out at the sea and listen to the
waves. In this comfortable
moment, no
words are needed to fill the silence.
Eventually, a
thought comes to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering the fragrance pouch I gave
her a while ago, I ask what
she put inside
it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I haven't put anything in it yet. But I
always carry it with me. Even
now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What should I keep in there? Which
fragrance should I choose?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I actually hadn't thought about what
would go inside the pouch when
I made it.
It doesn't even necessarily have to be a
fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Folding it up would be a no-no. Photos are
best kept in pristine
condition.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please give me some other ideas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I um and ah for a while, looking up at the
sky, then at the sea, and all
around for
inspiration. She stares quietly the whole
time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I do. It's in there already.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, look. The flowers are about to bloom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks burst into life across the night
sky, breaking the silence as
the sea
sparkles with their reflection.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From this angle, you can't see the flowers
in the sea. But I'm sure you
could see them
from inside the sea. Yeah, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My lens, you're very brightly colored right
now. Reflecting the sky,
just like the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The time we spent thinking about what to
put in the pouch, and the
time we spent
watching the fireworks... I've committed it
all to
memory.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So every time I look at the pouch, I'll
remember. This moment shared
between
only you and me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... But wait, that would make it a
memory pouch. I should probably
put a
fragrance in there too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Look for one with me. A scent as warm and
vivid as our memories of
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's basically spelled it out for
me, I finally understand
what she put in
the pouch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want the whole world to remember Aston
Machan. I want to make my
mark.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I also have one more wish. A new one,
hehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please remember every Machan
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The me from today, the me of tomorrow,
all the mes that will never be
seen by the
world—burn them into your lens, so they'll
never fade.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Shhh.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll test you myself to see if you still
remember, someday far, far in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And if you've forgotten, we'll open the
fragrance pouch together.
Then I'm sure
it'll all come back to you...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What expression I had on my face in this
moment, and what color you
had reflected
in yours.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
On that faraway day, we'll compare
answers. Okay?
